label: I18n
description: Provides language metadata, translation lookup, localized text extraction, and date/time formatting.

config.description: Current internationalization configuration, including lang, langs, datetime, and strings.

getMainLangs.description: Returns language IDs whose configuration entries have a truthy main flag.

getDefaultLang.description: Returns the configured default language ID (config.lang).

getLang.description: Returns the configured language entry for an ID, or null when missing.

returns.description: Language entry object, or null if not found.

getLangLabel.description: Returns the language label for an ID, falling back to the supplied ID.

translate.description: Looks up a label in config.strings[config.lang], returning the original label when no translation exists.

formatText.description: Extracts the text segment matching the requested language from an i18n:lang=... value; returns an empty string if no segment matches.

formatDateTime.description: Formats a date/time using the configured locale and date/time options; format 'iso' returns a UTC ISO-style string.

parameters.name: datetime
parameters.description: Date, date-time string, or compatible value; numeric input is explicitly converted to Date for 'iso' format.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Configured datetime format name, or 'iso'; omitted uses config.datetime.options.

parameters.name: opts
parameters.description: Additional Intl.DateTimeFormat options; the current implementation merges configured options into this object.

returns.description: Formatted date/time string; returns an empty string when datetime is an empty string.

setLanguage.description: Placeholder method only: currently logs a warning and does not change the language.

returns.description: Undefined; language switching is not yet implemented.
